epg.original_title: A Fish This Big / Fizz Fuzz Bang
epg.title: A Fish This Big / Fizz Fuzz Bang
epg.description: Howie is treated like a hero for saving a squirrel when really the squirrel saved him! Then, Poodle attacks the Banana Cabana with Cap'N Fizzy's pirate ship - it's up to Howie to stop her.

epg.original_title: Better Safe And Sorry / Narwhal's Contest
epg.title: Better Safe And Sorry / Narwhal's Contest
epg.description: Octo the safety monitor tries to make the Banana Cabana TOO safe - with dangerous results! Then, Narwhal's biggest fan wins a 'spend a day with Narwhal' contest - but she ends up falling for Howie!

epg.original_title: Cool Paw Howie / S.S. Banana Cabana
epg.title: Cool Paw Howie / S.S. Banana Cabana
epg.description: Looking for a new challenge, Howie converts the hotel into a minimum security prison. After an unexpected toilet mishap, the Banana Cabana winds up floating on the high seas - becoming a 'boatel'!

epg.title: Robo Howie / The Old Act
epg.description: Poodle builds a robot Howie and uses it to try to take over the Banana Cabana. Then, Narwhal's obnoxious old partner shows up - and wants to put the old act back together again.

epg.title: Jellyhead / Matter Over Mind
epg.description: A bossy Jellyfish sticks himself to Octo's head and starts to take over Octo's personality. Then, Howie gets the TV remote stuck to his head, and develops strange new powers!

epg.title: The Sun Howie Always Wanted
epg.description: After several days of bad weather, Duck builds an artificial sun that never goes down. Then, Narwhal confesses his greatest secret ever... he never learned how to swim!

epg.title: Gone Banana / Imaginary Fiend
epg.description: When the hotel's rooftop banana goes missing, Howie and Octo set out on an island-wide adventure to find it. Then, Howie's old imaginary friend comes to visit and drives everyone crazy.

epg.title: Who Inked The Bed? / Kikmee
epg.description: Octo's scary dreams have him staining his bedsheets in the shape of his pals. Then, Howie challenges Bunny that she can't get through a day without losing her temper.

epg.original_title: Candid Camaraderie / May The Best Loser Win
epg.title: Candid Camaraderie / May The Best Loser Win
epg.description: Poodle tries to humiliate the staff at the Banana Cabana by posting embarrassing videos of them online. Then, Octo's unable to set a record in Cap'n Fizzy's Big Book of Unnecessary Accomplishments.

epg.title: Piggy Party / Living Dangerously
epg.description: Howie and the gang try to throw a surprise Mud Day party for a very suspicious Piggy. Then, Howie becomes a product tester for Dirk Danger's line of extremely hazardous merchandise.

epg.original_title: The Orange Fizzy Blues / Champion Gurgitator
epg.title: The Orange Fizzy Blues / Champion Gurgitator
epg.description: Howie needs to collect all of the puzzle pieces to win an exclusive, limited edition can of Cap'n Fizzy's Fuzzy Orange Soda. Then, Howie comes out of 'retirement' to avenge Piggy.

epg.title: Piggy's Secret / Sloth Unleashed
epg.description: Howie and Octo try to find out why Piggy's behaving so mysteriously. Then, Howie attempts to train Sloth to be a stunter so she can join the Dirk Danger fan club.

epg.title: Stink Dog / Doll Pox
epg.description: Howie decides bathing is a waste of time so his friends are forced to attempt a 'stinkervention.' Then, Howie tries to get the chicken pox so he can join the rest of the gang in quarantine.

epg.original_title: Cat's Eight Lives / Crouching Narwhal, Hidden Piggy
epg.title: Cat's Eight Lives / Crouching Narwhal, Hidden Piggy
epg.description: Cat trades 8 of his 9 lives for Howie's old TV - but now he needs them back... but where did Howie put them? Then, Narwhal competes with Piggy on a ninjitsu-chef game show.

epg.title: Howiewe'en / Hotel of Horrors
epg.description: Octo tries to embrace the scariest night of the year - Howiewe'en - and goes too far. Then, Howie uses the haunted bathroom in the basement and is sucked into a very freaky world.

epg.original_title: The Perfect Gift / Home for the Howiedays
epg.title: The Perfect Gift / Home for the Howiedays
epg.description: Howie and the gang can't open their presents until Narwhal gets there... Where is he?! Then, Poodle and Batty reluctantly spend the Howiedays at the Banana Cabana.

epg.original_title: The Cabana Manana / Howie's Little Helper
epg.title: The Cabana Manana / Howie's Little Helper
epg.description: Howie and the gang try to convince Yeti that their hotel is too weird for him. Then, a young Chipmunk goes power-mad when Howie lets him manage the hotel for a day.

epg.title: Horn Swoggled / The Night Shift
epg.description: When Narwhal loses his horn, the source of his musical mojo, he switches jobs with Duck. Then, Howie discovers there's a night shift at the Banana Cabana, who have even more fun than the day shift!

epg.original_title: The Green Banana / Trash to the Past
epg.title: The Green Banana / Trash to the Past
epg.description: Howie attempts to 'go green'... but goes too far. Then, when garbage starts falling out of thin air, Howie and the gang try to figure out why!

epg.original_title: Howie's Pet Project / Dr. Howie and Mr. Howyena
epg.title: Howie's Pet Project / Dr. Howie and Mr. Howyena
epg.description: Bunny challenges irresponsible Howie to take care of a pineapple for a single afternoon. Then, Howie concocts a potion that turns him into an obnoxious and hairy! party animal.

epg.title: Needle Day / Octo vs. Batty
epg.description: Howie tries to figure out a sneaky way to give nervous Narwhal a needle. Then, Octo and Batty compete to see who can be the most evil, evil minion.

epg.original_title: The Brother and Sister Games / Freebies Jeebies
epg.title: The Brother and Sister Games / Freebies Jeebies
epg.description: Poodle reluctantly agrees to be Howie's teammate in a siblings-only competition. Then, Howie's brilliant Banana Cabana coupon plan backfires when too many guests show up at once.

epg.title: A Helping Paw / Howie's Staycation

epg.description: The newly fearless Octo becomes a little too fearless, even for Howie. Then, Octo and Narwhal discover they're related and try to learn more about each other.

epg.title: All Night Long / Camp Stinkawahway
epg.description: Howie and Octo try to stay awake all night long to win Dirk Danger's latest video game. Then, Howie treats the gang to a weekend getaway at Radiation Rooster's haunted campsite.

epg.title: Ducking Duck / Banana Split
epg.description: Howie discovers that Duck is royalty. Now Duck has to rule over the Banana Cabana. Then, a failed stunt splits the hotel into two halves that are now competing with each other.

epg.title: Cap'n Fizzy Fizzles / Banned!
epg.description: Howie tries to help his favourite soda-maker stay in business. Then, Mayor Trout - fed up with Howie and his stunting - BANS Howie.

epg.title: Bumbag Bummer / Dirk Dubious
epg.description: Sloth becomes famous for her Bumbag, which turns out to cause the dreaded Bumbag disorder! Then, Howie mistakenly thinks he's won a Day with Dirk contest, so Duck pretends to be Dirk.

epg.title: Pasta Wars
epg.description: There is a space invasion under Jon Arbuckle's roof, and the aliens are looking very much like Garfield's favourite meal: lasagnas.

epg.original_title: A Game of Cat and Mouse
epg.title: A Game of Cat and Mouse
epg.description: Squeak and his mice family have taken up residence in Garfield's house, to Jon's despair, who will deprive Garfield of lasagnas if he doesn't turn things back to normal.

epg.title: Perfect Pizza
epg.description: Garfield's favourite restaurant, Vito's Pizzeria, is in jeopardy. The evil Mama Meany wants to buy it to expand his own restaurant, with the PizzaGrand 7000 capable of making ten pizzas a minute.

epg.title: Mother Garfield
epg.description: A mother bluebird is locked in a neighbourhood garage, so who will care for her eggs? That's a job for Garfield, who is sometimes quite a mother hen.

epg.title: Pup in the Pound
epg.description: Odie is found by Al the Dogcatcher with no license on his collar so he puts him in the city pound with other stray dogs. Garfield will do everything to get his friend back.

epg.title: Odie in Love
epg.description: Odie falls in love with a brush. Garfield becomes a little bit jealous about that and decides to make the brush disappear.

epg.original_title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
epg.title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
epg.description: Jon finds an old accordion. It's unbearable for Garfield who totally dislikes this music. He will do everything to get rid of it.

epg.title: Turkey Trouble
epg.description: Jon has won a live turkey in a raffle and wants to prepare it for dinner, but he can't make up his mind to eat it. Neither can Garfield!

epg.title: Catnap
epg.description: Garfield and Odie are watching a horror movie... They're scared. Jon, who has forgotten his key, is knocking at the door. The two pets won't let him in until he's proven his identity.

epg.title: Agent X
epg.description: Garfield is angry. A fake, secret agent is trying to steal the show and his popularity among his friends.

epg.title: Orange and Black
epg.description: It's Halloween! Garfield goes trick or treating and disguises himself as a scary Catzilla. But the real Catzilla has just escaped from the city zoo and will spread panic in Garfield's neighbourhood.

epg.title: Freaky Monday
epg.description: Odie has been thrown out of the house by Garfield and spends all night outside on his own. An alien crashes his UFO in the garden and loses a key part necessary to get back home!

epg.title: King Nermal
epg.description: Nermal's owner has gone away on vacation and Jon has offered to look after Nermal while he's gone. Watch out, everybody! The cutest kitten in the world he says so himself is coming over for a week!

epg.title: Desperately Seeking Pooky
epg.description: Who has stolen Pooky? After a night drying on the clothes line, Pooky has disappeared, and Garfield can't sleep without him.

epg.title: Curse of the Were-Dog
epg.description: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie.

epg.title: Meet the Parents
epg.description: Liz's parents are coming over to meet Jon and Jon really has to make a good impression.

epg.title: Down on the Farm
epg.description: Jon goes to visit his brother, Doc Boy, who lives on a livestock farm. It's out in the country, and since Garfield is a real city cat, it's no picnic for him!

epg.title: The Pet Show
epg.description: There is a Pet Show in town, and the winner will get a huge lasagna from Vito's restaurant. That's worth trying for Garfield. But Nermal is in the competition too...

epg.title: Pet Matchers
epg.description: There's a new TV Show called 'Instant Petmatching', which is about seeing if pets are matching with their owner. The result of the test is that Jon and Garfield are incompatible!

epg.title: Lucky Charm
epg.description: Odie finds the pot of gold at the bottom of a rainbow. The owner, a leprechaun, will grant all the wishes Garfield can think of.

epg.title: Bone Diggers
epg.description: Odie has found a strange, big bone in the garden. After some research, Garfield has found that it might be a dinosaur bone, and that could make him rich... enough for having lasagna forever, at least!

epg.title: The Robot
epg.description: A salesman has sold Jon a cleaning Robot, which is very annoying to his two pets.

epg.title: High Scale
epg.description: Garfield is really unhappy because he has to be on diet. And he's having nightmares about it.

epg.title: Jon's Night Out
epg.description: Jon can't manage to sleep. He's tried everything, to no avail. But Dr. Somnambulo has a new machine: the hypno-doron, still in work-in-progress.

epg.title: Curse of the Cat People
epg.description: Liz brings back an old mirror from her travels in Egypt. This one is enchanted and opens a door towards ancient Egypt where a Goddess, Neferkitty, has a secret wish: conquering the human world.

epg.title: Glenda and Odessa
epg.description: Two little devilish girls are coming visiting Jon. They really want to play dolls with Garfield and Odie, who only want to stay clear from them.

epg.title: It's a Cat's World
epg.description: Garfield is stuck in a parallel world where cats have taken the place of humans, and vice versa!

epg.title: Extreme Housebreaking
epg.description: Jon sends Garfield to Dr Whipple's Show in order for him to learn how to be a well-behaved cat.

epg.title: Time Twist
epg.description: Garfield accidentally climbs into an outer space traveller's car, which sends him into parallel worlds.

epg.title: Fame Fatale
epg.description: Sir Leo, a famous TV Actor, looks very much like Garfield. So when he has to go on vacations, Garfield takes his place and gets to taste celebrity and glitter.

epg.title: Underwater World
epg.description: Our heroes are on a fishing trip. Odie saves a little fish and goes to explore the underwater world with Garfield.

epg.title: Fish to Fry
epg.description: Liz asks Jon to look after her goldfish while she's out of town. When Garfield finds this out, all he can think about is the great fry-up he's going to have.

epg.title: Little Yellow Riding Hood
epg.description: Our friends are having a picnic by the lake. There's an extra guest: a cute little wolf, who will become Odie's new friend.

epg.title: Time Master
epg.description: Garfield finds a watch which can stop time.

epg.title: Family Picture
epg.description: It's Liz's birthday and Jon wants to offer her a special gift: a nice family portrait. But taking this picture will be a gruelling experience for Garfield, Odie and Jon...

epg.title: Virtualodeon
epg.description: Professor Bonker has a new invention: the 'Virtualodeon', which will bring the characters of Garfield's favourite TV Shows right into his living-room.

epg.title: Mailman Blues
epg.description: Herman the Postman is going on holidays. He has left his round to the young Steart O'Meara, who hasn't yet encountered all of Garfield's devilish traps...

epg.title: Carolling Capers
epg.description: It's winter and Garfield and his friends, Odie and Nermal, are competing for the price of 'the best Christmas carolling singer'. There are cookies at stake!

epg.title: Heir Apparent
epg.description: Jon's cousin has passed away and has left his fortune to Jon and Doc Boy. But there's one condition: the one who will spend an entire night in a spooky manor will be the one to inherit everything.

epg.title: From the Oven
epg.description: After Garfield slightly changes the recipe of Odie's birthday cake, it comes to life and spreads panic in town!

epg.title: Neighbour Nathan
epg.description: Garfield has been mean to Odie again. Left in the garden, he's taken in by a neighbour, Nathan. Odie is happy with this new friendship, but he soon discovers that Garfield wasn't that bad after all...

epg.title: History of Dogs
epg.description: Garfield takes us through the ages to tell us the history of dogs. As we know, he has a poor opinion of them, but an incident will make him change his mind. After all, all dogs are not useless!

epg.title: Up a Tree
epg.description: Garfield is bored. He has nothing to do. Well, not exactly: watching Odie and the squirrels in the garden, there's fun ahead after all!

epg.title: It's a Cheese World
epg.description: Eddie Gourmand has built a super attraction park, made completely out of cheese. Squeak and his friends beg Garfield to take them there but with Harry working as a security guard, it won't be easy!

epg.title: Nice to Nermal
epg.description: Pooky has disappeared again, but this time, it's Nermal who finds it. He is willing to give it back to him at one condition: Garfield has to be really nice to Nermal for the rest of the day!

epg.title: Out on a Limb
epg.description: Garfield's cat instincts push him to climb on a tree. But how will he get down? Everyone tries to give him a hand, but they end up stuck in that tree! Now he's out on a limb; who will save him?

epg.title: Super Me
epg.description: Nermal doesn't believe in super heroes. Garfield does and he tries desperately to convince him. Even if that means disguising himself as Ultra Powerful Guy.

epg.title: Mastermind
epg.description: Garfield receives a strange helmet which lets him read everyone's thoughts. He even catches aliens' conversations who are just about to conquer Earth! Garfield has to stop this plot immediately!

epg.title: The Amazing Flying Dog
epg.description: After Odie dreams of being a super hero, Garfield mocks him for it. But when Garfield really gets into trouble, Odie puts his grudges aside and flies off to help him. And this time he REALLY flies!

epg.title: The Last Word
epg.description: Nermal makes a bet with Garfield: if Garfield manages not to eat for a whole hour, he won't see Nermal for a whole month. Will Garfield be victorious ?

epg.title: Iceman
epg.description: A caveman has been found in a block of ice. When Garfield accidentally thaws him, he falls in love with Olga. But if there's no caveman in the new exhibit, the museum will be ruined!

epg.title: T3000
epg.description: There's a new employee at the pound: it's a robot with all the latest gadgets and it's job to make all the pets stick to the straight and narrow!

epg.title: Home for the Holidays - Part 1
epg.description: Tis the holiday season for Garfield and the whole gang. Jon has invited not only his parents and Doc Boy, but Liz's family as well, and so Garfield must be on his best behaviour.

epg.title: Home for the Holidays - Part 2
epg.description: Jon's Christmas plans take a turn for the unexpected, prompting Garfield to learn that there's more to Christmas than opening presents and eating!

epg.title: The Art of Being Uncute
epg.description: How can Garfield make the cutest cat in the country look ugly? It won't be easy but our orange friend is VERY motivated...

epg.title: The Haunted House
epg.description: Ah! A pizza dinner in a countryside cottage, doesn't that sound nice? Yep, except when the house is haunted.

epg.title: Night of the Bunny Slippers
epg.description: How can Garfield get rid of Aunt Ivy, who hates animals? Garfield has an idea.

epg.title: Planet of Poultry
epg.description: When the owner of an outer space fast food chain plans to turn all the inhabitants of Earth into chickens, Garfield becomes our unlikely hero.

epg.title: History of Cats
epg.description: A retelling of the history of the cat throughout time, as told by Garfield. But is it really a retelling of history, or a rewriting?

epg.title: The Spy Who Fed Me
epg.description: Garfield, from now on, you're on a diet! Don't argue, it's for your own good!

epg.title: Gravity of the Situation
epg.description: Gravity-free cooking, have you ever heard of such a thing? According to Garfield, it's delicious...

epg.title: Ticket to Riches
epg.description: Yahooooo! Jon has won the lottery!!! But... but where is his ticket?

epg.title: Which Witch
epg.description: Bad news: Jon's nieces are coming over! The ones who love to dress Garfield up? You got it.

epg.title: The Big Sneeze
epg.description: Jon has become allergic to Garfield. But what if the only solution is to get rid of him?

epg.title: Blasteroid
epg.description: Garfield has always said he would go to the ends of the earth to eat lasagna. And that's exactly what he's going to do!

epg.title: Meet Max Mouse
epg.description: In your opinion, who should you call to rid a house of mice? An exterminator, or Garfield?

epg.title: Odie for Sale
epg.description: Odie is accidentally sold to Mr. Allwork, an awful lawyer who wants to sue Jon, and Garfield must find a way to get him back or never be fed again!

epg.title: Guest From Beyond
epg.description: Jon, Odie and especially Garfield have to put up with an unexpected houseguest with big demands and an even bigger appetite.

epg.title: Cyber Mailman
epg.description: It would be fantastic to get tomorrow's newspaper today, wouldn't it? Jon could play all the winning numbers in the lottery and then Garfield could eat tons of pizza, unless...

epg.title: Farm Fresh Feline
epg.description: So Garfield's been working the fields like nobody else? Has he been hypnotised or what?! Well... anything's possible...

epg.title: With Four You Get Pizza
epg.description: What starts out as a romantic night at Vito's for Jon and Liz could end up in a marriage with children, all thanks to Garfield stomach.

epg.title: Master Chef
epg.description: Garfield will stop at nothing to get his hands on Chef Squisito's lasagna, which his wistful student claims is the 'best lasagna in the world.'

epg.title: Honey, I Shrunk the Pets
epg.description: Garfield is the unwilling guinea pig for his young neighbour's newest invention: a size altering ray.

epg.title: Garfield Astray
epg.description: When Nermal's revenge on Garfield goes wrong, Garfield finds himself roaming the streets with no memory of who he is.

epg.title: Black Cat Blues
epg.description: Garfield has to survive a day filled with nothing but bad luck after crossing paths with Jonah, a sad black cat.

epg.title: Dog Days
epg.description: Odie and the people he has licked are somehow making everyone act like dogs: it's a canine contagion! No one will be spared without the help of Garfield, who for some reason is immune.

epg.title: The Bluebird of Happiness
epg.description: Garfield must save a lost baby bluebird from finding a new home: Harry's stomach!

epg.title: Inside Eddie Gourmand
epg.description: What's eating Eddie Gourmand? That's what Garfield is about to find out thanks to a new invention that allows him to get inside his brain.

epg.title: Depths of a Salesman
epg.description: When Jon, Odie and Garfield are duped by items they've bought on the All-Buying-Stuff Channel, Garfield discovers it's going to take more than a polite request to get their money back.

epg.title: Night of the Apparatuses
epg.description: Jon's new super computer program, Millie, has taken over all the appliances in the house and will not stop until it has taken over the world!

epg.title: Everything's Relative
epg.description: An emergency fumigation prompts Aunt Ivy to impose herself on Jon, Odie and Garfield, leaving Jon with the responsibility of yet another cumbersome character.

epg.title: Land of Hold
epg.description: What if every person in the world were just waiting for their call to be taken, their life always on hold? Garfield is about to find out.

epg.title: Fido Food Feline
epg.description: Garfield has always stayed away from cat food, opting instead for people food. After seeing his stray cat friends being fed some, he remembers how that came to be.

epg.title: Cuter than Cute
epg.description: When the leader of the lasagna planet, Parma, sends in a spy in the form of a cuter version of Nermal to gain information on Garfield's weakness, his mission to invade the planet may be compromised...

epg.title: A Gripping Tale
epg.description: Garfield and Odie have their own undersea adventure when a giant squid takes Odie and starts wreaking havoc in the city sewers.

epg.title: Penny Henny
epg.description: It's the tale of Penny Henny, revisited, as Jon tells the story of the chicken who believed the sky was falling all because of one orange cat.

epg.title: Wicked Wishes
epg.description: When Jon unleashes a trickster genie in a bottle, he gets the tables turned on him and must grant the genie his three wishes lest he be turned into a frog.

epg.title: Jumbo Shrimpy
epg.description: Shrimpy the Elephant is being mistreated by Dr. Whipple. When he escapes, it's up to Garfield to help him stay hidden.

epg.title: Pirate Gold
epg.description: Captain Garfield's ship is under attack by a group of rival pirates, Rottweiller, Hercules and Wilfred, who are after his treasure.

epg.title: Me, Garfield and I
epg.description: Things soon get out of hand when Garfield gets his paws on Dr. Bonkers cloning ray.

epg.title: Great Pizza Race
epg.description: Garfield puts Vito's skill and patience to the test when he hatches up a plan to exploit Vito's 'pizza delivery under 20 minutes or else the pizza is free' offer.

epg.title: Full of Beans
epg.description: When Odie swallows a Mexican jumping bean, he becomes a doggy bouncing ball and takes Garfield for a wild ride all over the town.

epg.title: Detective Odie
epg.description: Jon is taken by the police when he is wrongly accused of stealing Mrs. Shmidlap's bracelet. It's up to Odie to find out what really happened.

epg.title: Stealing Home
epg.description: Bruno, an alley cat, is sick and tired of watching Garfield get waited on hand and foot while he has to live in a trash can. And so he decides to make Garfield's home his own.

epg.title: Love and Lasagna
epg.description: Could this be the end of Vito's Pizzeria? Garfield must save the two loves of Vito's life from the hands of Brent Mogul, real estate tycoon.

epg.title: True Colours
epg.description: Dr. Goodiegoodie, an old TV show Jon used to watch, is no ordinary show. It's the show that watches you. When Dr. Goodiegoodie sees Garfield being mean to Nermal, he decides to punish him...

epg.title: Rain or Shine
epg.description: Paddy the Leprechaun has brought the rain with him and ruined Jon and Liz's trip to the beach. Garfield and Odie think they're saved from the clutches of Aunt Ivy.

epg.title: Mind Over Mouse
epg.description: Squeak has the power to see the future. How you may ask? Garfield doesn't care so long as he can make big bucks off of it. But when's Squeak's new 'power' suddenly runs out, it's Jon on the line!

epg.title: The Big Sleep
epg.description: Garfield is preparing for hibernation. But sleeping for months when you live with others isn't so easy after all, especially when they can get you into trouble without you even knowing!

epg.title: Pampered Pussycat
epg.description: Garfield and Odie show the pampered and spoiled, but lonely Prince Orloff what fun and playing is all about. Or at least Odie does, while Garfield watches.

epg.title: The Mole Express
epg.description: When a mole's tunnel collapses Jon's yard, affecting Garfield's friends, the strays, and squirrels, Garfield comes up with a master plan that just might solve everyone's problems.

epg.title: Piggy's Secret / Sloth Unleashed
epg.description: Howie and Octo try to find out why Piggy's behaving so mysteriously. Then, Howie attempts to train Sloth to be a stunter so she can join the Dirk Danger fan club.

epg.title: Stink Dog / Doll Pox
epg.description: Howie decides bathing is a waste of time so his friends are forced to attempt a 'stinkervention.' Then, Howie tries to get the chicken pox so he can join the rest of the gang in quarantine.

epg.original_title: Cat's Eight Lives / Crouching Narwhal, Hidden Piggy
epg.title: Cat's Eight Lives / Crouching Narwhal, Hidden Piggy
epg.description: Cat trades 8 of his 9 lives for Howie's old TV - but now he needs them back... but where did Howie put them? Then, Narwhal competes with Piggy on a ninjitsu-chef game show.

epg.title: Howiewe'en / Hotel of Horrors
epg.description: Octo tries to embrace the scariest night of the year - Howiewe'en - and goes too far. Then, Howie uses the haunted bathroom in the basement and is sucked into a very freaky world.

epg.original_title: The Perfect Gift / Home for the Howiedays
epg.title: The Perfect Gift / Home for the Howiedays
epg.description: Howie and the gang can't open their presents until Narwhal gets there... Where is he?! Then, Poodle and Batty reluctantly spend the Howiedays at the Banana Cabana.

epg.original_title: The Cabana Manana / Howie's Little Helper
epg.title: The Cabana Manana / Howie's Little Helper
epg.description: Howie and the gang try to convince Yeti that their hotel is too weird for him. Then, a young Chipmunk goes power-mad when Howie lets him manage the hotel for a day.

epg.title: Horn Swoggled / The Night Shift
epg.description: When Narwhal loses his horn, the source of his musical mojo, he switches jobs with Duck. Then, Howie discovers there's a night shift at the Banana Cabana, who have even more fun than the day shift!

epg.original_title: The Green Banana / Trash to the Past
epg.title: The Green Banana / Trash to the Past
epg.description: Howie attempts to 'go green'... but goes too far. Then, when garbage starts falling out of thin air, Howie and the gang try to figure out why!

epg.original_title: Howie's Pet Project / Dr. Howie and Mr. Howyena
epg.title: Howie's Pet Project / Dr. Howie and Mr. Howyena
epg.description: Bunny challenges irresponsible Howie to take care of a pineapple for a single afternoon. Then, Howie concocts a potion that turns him into an obnoxious and hairy! party animal.

epg.title: Needle Day / Octo vs. Batty
epg.description: Howie tries to figure out a sneaky way to give nervous Narwhal a needle. Then, Octo and Batty compete to see who can be the most evil, evil minion.

epg.original_title: The Brother and Sister Games / Freebies Jeebies
epg.title: The Brother and Sister Games / Freebies Jeebies
epg.description: Poodle reluctantly agrees to be Howie's teammate in a siblings-only competition. Then, Howie's brilliant Banana Cabana coupon plan backfires when too many guests show up at once.

epg.title: A Helping Paw / Howie's Staycation
epg.description: Howie decides that Sloth needs a personal assistant, so it's up to Howie to find her one. Then, Howie goes on a much-needed vacation - at the Banana Cabana!

epg.title: Octo P.I. / The Lost Stunt
epg.description: While writing his detective novel, Octo uncovers a genuine mystery in the Banana Cabana - the case of the missing spit sock! Then, Howie tries to prove that he's Dirk Danger's number one fan.

epg.title: Almost Naked Animals Ep 8
epg.description: Sloth hypnotises Howie to be 'romantic' and discovers she likes the regular Howie better. Then, Howie tries to help Piggy woo a repulsive warthog.

epg.title: Octo Gets Tough / Narwhal's Birthday
epg.description: The newly fearless Octo becomes a little too fearless, even for Howie. Then, Octo and Narwhal discover they're related and try to learn more about each other.

epg.title: All Night Long / Camp Stinkawahway
epg.description: Howie and Octo try to stay awake all night long to win Dirk Danger's latest video game. Then, Howie treats the gang to a weekend getaway at Radiation Rooster's haunted campsite.

epg.title: Ducking Duck / Banana Split
epg.description: Howie discovers that Duck is royalty. Now Duck has to rule over the Banana Cabana. Then, a failed stunt splits the hotel into two halves that are now competing with each other.

epg.title: Cap'n Fizzy Fizzles / Banned!
epg.description: Howie tries to help his favourite soda-maker stay in business. Then, Mayor Trout - fed up with Howie and his stunting - BANS Howie.

epg.title: Bumbag Bummer / Dirk Dubious
epg.description: Sloth becomes famous for her Bumbag, which turns out to cause the dreaded Bumbag disorder! Then, Howie mistakenly thinks he's won a Day with Dirk contest, so Duck pretends to be Dirk.

epg.title: Miss Surrounding Area / Campaign Pains
epg.description: Bunny goes up against Batty - who's disguised as a girl - in the local beauty contest. Then, Howie runs for mayor - then tries his best NOT to get elected when he finds out how much work being mayor i

epg.title: The Rotation Situation
epg.description: Duck speeds up the rotation of the earth so Howie's birthday will arrive sooner... and makes everyone old! Then, Howie sets out to re-accomplish everything he's ever accomplished... in just one aftern

epg.original_title: The Big Burp Theory / Who's Howie?
epg.title: The Big Burp Theory / Who's Howie?
epg.description: Howie tries not to unleash the world's nastiest burp during his royal thighness Chicken A La King's visit! Then, Howie bonks his head and forgets who he is...

epg.original_title: Inane in the Brain / Laugh Piggy Laugh
epg.title: Inane in the Brain / Laugh Piggy Laugh
epg.description: Using Duck's latest invention, Octo and Bunny venture inside Howie's brain to retrieve a lost password. Then, Howie and his pals have to help Piggy regain his sense of humour!

epg.title: Picture Day / Part Timer
epg.description: Howie tries to help the gang prepare for Staff Picture Day - with disastrous results. Then, Howie tries to find an exciting part-time job so he can be on his favourite TV show 'Hired Hounds.'

epg.title: Howie's Allergy / Figure Fight
epg.description: When Howie is forced to give up sugar, he suddenly becomes a successful stunter and brainiac. Then, Howie and Octo find a one-of-a-kind Dirk Danger action figure and disagree about what to do with it.

epg.title: Mini Howies / Dear Dirk
epg.description: Duck gives Howie a batch of mini-Howies - who then go on a rampage with Duck's mini-Ducks. Then, Howie gets the job of answering Dirk's mail and makes a promise to a fan that Dirk can't fulfil!

epg.original_title: These Sleeps Were Made For Walkin'
epg.title: These Sleeps Were Made For Walkin'
epg.description: Octo competes in a sleepwalking tournament to try to win a fancy new bunk bed. Then, a fortune cookie tells Octo and Howie that they need to find new best friends or disaster will befall them.

epg.original_title: Don't Follow the Leader / The Snow-tel
epg.title: Don't Follow the Leader / The Snow-tel
epg.description: Piggy reluctantly helps Howie and Octo finally win a role-playing game of Dirks and Dragons. Then, Batty invokes the Penguin Clause and tries to take over the hotel.

epg.original_title: Luck Be a Robot / Family Business
epg.title: Luck Be a Robot / Family Business
epg.description: Howie convinces Bunny to be his lucky charm for the Robot Ruckus tournament. Then, Poodle and Howie have to run a successful business together for one day - or lose their hotels.

epg.title: No Howie's Allowed / Howie Day
epg.description: Octo, Piggy and Narwhal try to keep an overly-excited Howie from ruining Bunny's sleepover. Then, Howie tries to do enough good deeds to convince the mayor he's worthy of his own special day.

epg.title: Sun Scream / It's Duck's Party
epg.description: A bad batch of sun screen makes everyone's biggest fears come true. Then, Narwhal has to keep Howie and the others from sneaking into Duck's very exclusive party.

epg.original_title: Father's Day / Hambo 1: Galactic Super Swine of the Wild West
epg.title: Father's Day / Hambo 1: Galactic Super Swine of the Wild West
epg.description: Duck finds an egg. Thinking it must be his, he excitedly prepares for fatherhood. Then, when Dirk Danger gives up stunting to become a chef, Piggy is chosen to be the next big action movie star.

epg.original_title: It's My Party / One Star Hotel
epg.title: It's My Party / One Star Hotel
epg.description: Howie and the gang get trapped in the basement during the biggest party of the year. Then, the Banana Cabana needs to get one star from a reviewer or Howie will lose the hotel.
